entries.name: User caches
entries.hint: Application caches for the current user. They speed up loading.
entries.impact: Apps rebuild these; the first launch after cleaning is slower.

entries.name: User logs
entries.hint: Log files written by applications, used for debugging.
entries.impact: Apps start a new log file on their next run.

entries.name: Trash
entries.hint: Items already in the Trash. Their space is only freed when the Trash is emptied.

entries.name: Temporary data
entries.hint: Files and folders in this user's temporary directories. Small files and lock files are omitted.
entries.impact: An application may need to recreate temporary data; close apps before cleaning.

entries.name: Windows local temporary data
entries.hint: Temporary files under the current Windows account.
entries.impact: Applications may need to recreate temporary files; close apps before cleaning.

entries.name: Shared temporary data
entries.hint: Shared system temporary areas may hold files owned by other users or active services.
entries.impact: Removing live temporary files can disrupt applications and services.

entries.name: Crash reports
entries.hint: Application crash diagnostics for this account.
entries.impact: Old crash diagnostics will no longer be available for debugging.

entries.name: Font caches
entries.hint: Generated font indexes for this account.
entries.impact: Fonts may load more slowly while the cache is rebuilt.

entries.name: Spotlight indexes
entries.hint: Per-volume Spotlight search indexes on macOS.
entries.impact: Search results are unavailable or incomplete while macOS rebuilds the index.
